import FreeCAD
import Part

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

# Set the active document and body
FreeCAD.setActiveDocument(doc.Name)
body = doc.getObject("Body")
FreeCAD.ActiveDocument.setObjectTip(body)

# Get the pad
pad = doc.getObject("Pad")

# Create a mirror feature - mirror the pad across XZ_Plane
mirror = body.addObject("PartDesign::Mirror", "Mirror")
mirror.BaseFeature = [pad]
mirror.MirrorType = "Plane"
mirror.MirrorPlane = ("XZ_Plane", "Base")

# Recompute
doc.recompute()

print("Mirror created successfully")
print(f"Mirror object: {mirror.Name}")
print(f"Mirror BaseFeature: {mirror.BaseFeature}")
print(f"Mirror Plane: {mirror.MirrorPlane}")

# Check the resulting shape
if hasattr(mirror, 'Shape') and mirror.Shape:
    print(f"Mirror Shape has {len(mirror.Shape.Solids)} solid(s)")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
EOF
